battle.name: 黑石之戰
battle.brief: 隋大業十三年十月，瓦崗軍主李密在河南鞏縣南黑石大破隋將王世充。十月廿五日，王世充夜渡洛水營於黑石，次日會戰洛北，隋軍依險先勝，護軍柴孝和溺死；李密率精騎直趨敵營，迫其放棄月城回救，斬首二千餘級。十一月石子河再戰，隋軍又潰。卡面羅馬弩砲距此役六百餘年，不在現場。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場戰爭是隋朝中央軍與瓦崗軍在大業十三年十月至十二月間，於河南洛口一帶連續爆發的三次對抗。隋方由坐鎮東都的越王侗調兵：虎賁郎將劉長恭率留守兵、寵玉率偃師兵，與江都通守王世充、韋霽、王辯及河內通守孟善誼、河陽郡尉獨孤武都會合，總計十餘萬眾，一體由王世充節度，隋煬帝亦自江都下詔，詔諸軍皆受世充調遣。瓦崗方則是李密接掌翟讓部眾之後組成的聯軍，以李密為元帥、翟讓為司徒，麾下有郝孝德、裴仁基、王伯當、單雄信、徐世勣、柴孝和等將，兵眾《資治通鑑》稱「密眾數十萬」。兩軍爭奪的核心是洛口倉：瓦崗軍久圍此倉，隋兵若能解圍，東都的城防與人心便可安穩；反之倉廩盡歸李密，東都便只剩一座空城。外圍還有第三方勢力在動：竇建德據河北，杜伏威據江淮，李淵的唐軍則在同年十月入關中、十一月克長安，於是洛陽與長安兩處樞紐在同月內一西一東相繼易手，整個中原的權力版圖在半年之間被重新畫過。
countriesEn: This war was a series of three clashes fought between the central Sui army and the Wagang insurgents in the Luokou district of Henan between the tenth and the twelfth months of the Daye thirteenth year, that is 617. On the Sui side, the Prince of Yue, Tong, who held the dynasty's nominal authority at the eastern capital of Luoyang, called up the garrison troops under the Tiger Guard Colonel Liu Changgong and the troops of Yanshi under Chongyu; these were joined by Wang Shichong, the Circuit Commander of Jiangdu, by Wei Ji and Wang Bian, and by Meng Shanyi, the Circuit Commander of Henei, and Dugu Wudu, the Commandant of Heyang. The combined host numbered more than a hundred thousand men, and the whole of it was placed under the command of Wang Shichong by an edict of Emperor Yang issued from Jiangdu. The Wagang side was the coalition Li Mi had assembled after taking over the followers of Zhai Rang, with Li Mi as commander and Zhai Rang as marshal; among its generals were Hao Xiaode, Pei Renji, Wang Bodang, Shan Xiongxin, Xu Shiji and Chai Xiaohe, and the Zizhi Tongjian describes the Wagang host as several tens of thousands of men under Li Mi. What the two sides fought over was the granary of Luokou. The Wagang army had been besieging it for months, and a relief of the siege would steady the walls and the temper of the eastern capital; the other way, if the storehouse fell to Li Mi, all that remained to Luoyang would be an empty city. Third parties were moving on the edges of the field as well: Dou Jiande in the north, Du Fuwei along the Yangtze, and the Tang forces of Li Yuan, who entered Guanzhong in the tenth month and took Chang'an in the eleventh. Luoyang and Chang'an, the two pivots of the dynasty, therefore changed hands within a single month, one to the east and one to the west, and the whole map of authority in the central plains was redrawn inside half a year.
people: 決定全場走勢的是李密。他本為隋朝宿衛出身，天下大亂後輾轉河南，大業十二年率眾投奔瓦崗，以才略與翟讓並駕齊驅，旋為全軍主帥，取魏公之號。翟讓是瓦崗的起家首領，起義之初聚眾於滑州瓦崗寨，後與李密合作卻始終不甘居其下；其司馬王儒信勸他自為大冢宰，總統眾務，事為左長史房彥藻與左司馬鄭頲所進言，李密遂於同年十二月置酒設席，遣壯士蔡建德自後斫殺翟讓及其兄弘、侄摩侯，司馬王儒信並死，徐世勣頸受傷，單雄信叩頭請命才得免。瓦崗自此權歸李密，內部平衡亦從此破裂。隋方主角王世充出身寒微，好武而不讀書，善使刀槊，久任江都通守，是隋廷在東都最倚重的將領；黑石初敗之後他「慚懼」，仍主動請戰於密，十一月石子河再敗才「堅壁不出」，翌年終於反噬洛陽自立為帝。護軍柴孝和是最可惜的損失：黑石初戰失利時他縋水溺亡，瓦崗最銳的一支攻略力量就此折損。裴仁基、王伯當、單雄信、徐世勣在石子河合擊中各有功，隋將費青奴則死於十二月偷襲洛口倉的敗仗，張季珣以數百人孤守箕山數月，糧盡水竭而不降。
peopleEn: The man who decided the course of the whole affair was Li Mi. A former guard officer of the Sui court, he had moved about Henan as the state came apart, and in the twelfth year of Daye he brought his followers to join Zhai Rang at Wagang. His talent for command, at first equal to Zhai Rang's and then something better, carried him to the head of the entire force and to the title of Duke of Wei. Zhai Rang was the founder of the movement, having first gathered a band at Wanggang in the region of Hua, and he fought beside Li Mi but never accepted being the second man. His adjutant Wang Ruxin urged him to take the title of Grand Chancellor and take charge of all affairs, and the matter was carried to Li Mi by Fang Yanzhao, the Left Director of the Secretariat, and by Zheng Ting, the Left Adjutant of the War Office. In the twelfth month of the same year Li Mi laid on a banquet and had the bravest man in his own guard, Cai Jiande, cut down Zhai Rang from behind, together with his elder brother Hong, his nephew Mohou and the adjutant Wang Ruxin; Xu Shiji had his neck wounded in the doorway and Shan Xiongxin knocked his head to the ground and begged for his life before being released. From that day the authority of the Wagang army was Li Mi's alone, and the balance inside the movement was broken as well. The Sui commander of the day was Wang Shichong. Born poor and orphaned, a soldier by temperament who cared for arms and riding rather than for books, he had long served as Circuit Commander of Jiangdu and was the man on whom the Sui state at Luoyang leaned hardest. After the first defeat at Heishi he was 'ashamed and apprehensive', yet he still asked to be allowed to fight Li Mi; only after the second defeat at Shizihe did he hold his walls and refuse to give battle. The gravest loss on the Wagang side was Chai Xiaohe: in the failed action at Heishi he was dragged down by the current and drowned in the Luo, and the sharpest of the Wagang armies' assaulting power was broken with him. Pei Renji, Wang Bodang, Shan Xiongxin and Xu Shiji each did their part in the combined stroke at Shizihe, while on the Sui side Fei Qingnu was killed in the night attempt on the Luokou granary in the twelfth month, and Zhang Xixun held the lone fortress of Jishan with a few hundred men for months on end, refusing to surrender even when his grain ran out and his water failed.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲（Scorpio）是公元前一世紀的扭力式單發重弩：一次上弦蓄力，發射一具鐵箭，箭道沉重，足以在城牆上砸出缺口，羅馬人正是用它拆掉希臘的城牆與城邦體系。它與大業十三年相隔六百餘年，不可能出現在河南的戰場上，此役現場的投射兵器另有其物。隋軍的同原理裝備是床弩、蹶張弩、車弩這類靠弩機蓄能的重型弩具，另有拋車、飛石一類拋射器械，以及雲梯、巢車、攻城車、撞車等攻城裝備，與羅馬弩砲同屬「以機械把蓄存的力量投射出去」的思路，只是尺度與材料各異。隋軍的骨幹是步兵、騎兵與攻城部隊的混合體：披重甲持長槊的步卒在前列結陣，弩手與弓手在後掩護，輕騎繞側遊擊；隋文帝時所置、楊素率領的玄甲騎兵是其中精銳，人馬皆著黑甲，常作鋒線使用。地形上洛水橫亘作戰場，渡河靠舟船與泅渡，王世充夜渡洛水一舉成功，正說明水障是當時最大的戰術變數。糧械裝備同樣是命脈：洛口倉是隋朝為東都經營的最大倉儲，圍倉與爭倉就是爭命脈，同年東都米價一度騰至每斗三千錢，軍隊的給養與徵發緊張由此可見。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman scorpio, the torsion-powered single-shot heavy crossbow of the first century BC: it is wound once to store its strength and then looses a single heavy iron bolt, and the bolt flies with enough weight to breach a wall. It was with such machines that the Romans pulled down the walls and the civic order of the Greek cities. The weapon stands more than six hundred years away from the Daye thirteenth year and cannot have been on the field in Henan; the artillery actually present there belonged to another family. The Sui possessed equivalents in the heavy crossbows driven by the tension of a lathe, the bed crossbow, the draw-weight crossbow and the carriage crossbow, and beyond these the catapult-like pao che and hurling stones for siege work, together with scaling ladders, siege towers, battering gates and rams. All of them share the scorpio's underlying idea, that of a machine which throws stored force at a target, differing only in scale and material. The backbone of the Sui army was a mixture of foot, horse and engineers: spearmen in heavy armour formed the front line, crossbowmen and archers covered them from behind, and light horse worked round the flanks. The elite of the Sui cavalry was the Xuanjia, horse and rider both in black armour, raised under Emperor Wen and led by Yang Su, habitually used as the leading edge of an assault. The Luo River lay across the field, and the armies crossed it by boat and by swimming; the night crossing of the Luo that opened the battle shows what a water obstacle meant in practice. Supplies were the other vital point: Luokou was the largest storehouse the Sui state maintained for the eastern capital, and in the same year the price of grain in Luoyang ran to three thousand cash for a dou. To hold the granary and to keep the road to it open was to hold the life of the army.
tactics: 黑石一戰的勝負手不在正面，而在繞營。十月廿五日入夜，王世充率軍夜渡洛水，駐營黑石；次日分兵守營，自將精兵陳於洛水北岸，李密聞訊引兵渡洛逆戰，密軍大敗，柴孝和溺死，餘眾東走月城，世充追而圍之。李密隨即率精騎渡洛南，從南面直馳黑石大營，營中驚恐，連舉六烽告急，王世充被迫放棄月城，狼狽回救，李密回身再戰，隋軍大潰，斬首二千餘級。這是典型的攻其所必救：把敵軍主力吸在攻城線上，再用騎兵打擊其營壘與指揮中樞，逼敵分兵回援，在回援的隊形裡再度邀擊。十一月石子河之戰，李密把陣列南北展開十餘里，先以翟讓接戰失利而退，王伯當、裴仁基橫斷敵軍後路，李密勒中軍反擊，世充大敗西走，屬縱深陣地加兩翼鉗擊的配合。十二月廿四夜襲洛口倉，瓦崗設伏邀擊，一度攻入倉城又被迫退出。整體看，隋軍的弱點在營壘鬆散、缺乏縱深預備：營地被襲要靠連舉六烽才求救，說明其警戒層級與縱深配置都嫌單薄。
tacticsEn: The decisive turn at Heishi was not fought in the front but by going round the camp. On the night of the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month Wang Shichong crossed the Luo in darkness and encamped at Heishi; on the following day he split off a detachment to hold the camp and deployed his picked troops on the north bank of the river, and when Li Mi heard of it he led his army across the Luo to meet him. The Wagang were beaten, Chai Xiaohe drowned, the rest of the broken force ran east to Yuecheng, and Wang Shichong pursued and surrounded them there. Li Mi then took his heavy cavalry back across the river to the south and rode straight at the Sui camp at Heishi; the camp was panic-stricken and raised beacon fires one after another, six in all, to signal distress, and Wang Shichong had to give up the siege of Yuecheng and come back in disorder to save his headquarters. Li Mi turned and met him, and the Sui army was destroyed, with more than two thousand heads taken according to the Zizhi Tongjian. This is the classic stroke of attacking what the enemy cannot abandon: draw his main body onto the assault line, then send horse against his camp and his command centre, force him to divide and come back, and intercept him again while he is on the move. At the battle of Shizihe in the eleventh month Li Mi deployed his line over ten li from north to south, put Zhai Rang in front, who gave ground, and while Wang Shichong pursued him, Wang Bodang and Pei Renji cut across the Sui rear, after which Li Mi held his centre and struck, and Wang Shichong was badly beaten and fled west. That is a deep deployment closed by a pincer on the two wings. The night of the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth month brought the attempt on the Luokou granary, in which the Wagang lay in ambush and let the Sui into the storehouse before cutting them off. Taken as a whole, the Sui weakness lay in loose camps and the absence of any reserve in depth: when the headquarters was struck, six beacons in succession were needed to call for help, which shows how thin their system of warning and how slight their echeloning.
data: 有根據可寫的數字大致如下。隋方兵力：越王侗遣虎賁郎將劉長恭、寵玉等，會王世充、韋霽、王辯、孟善誼、獨孤武都，總「合十餘萬眾」擊李密於洛口。瓦崗軍：《資治通鑑》記「密眾數十萬」圍箕山，張季珣所領不過數百人，孤城自三月被圍至十月才陷，攻防實力相差之巨可見一斑。黑石之戰斬首數，《資治通鑑》作二千餘級，另有戰記作三千餘級；護軍柴孝和溺死。黑石營中告急連舉六烽。李密在石子河的陣列南北十餘里，縱深約合五公里以上。十一月石子河之戰，隋軍大敗西走，未有斬獲數記載。十二月廿四洛口倉之役，隋軍戰死溺死千餘人，驍將費青奴被殺。糧價方面，同年東都米價騰至每斗三千錢。時間線上，自十月廿五日夜渡洛水起，至十二月廿四偷襲倉城止，前後約兩個月，期間隋軍先勝後敗再敗，攻守之勢在黑石與石子河之間徹底倒轉。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The strength of the Sui force: the Prince of Yue sent the Tiger Guard Colonel Liu Changgong, Chongyu and the others, who joined Wang Shichong, Wei Ji, Wang Bian, Meng Shanyi and Dugu Wudu, and the combined host that struck at Li Mi at Luokou numbered more than a hundred thousand men. The Wagang army: the Zizhi Tongjian records that when several tens of thousands of men under Li Mi surrounded Jishan, Zhang Xixun, who held it, had no more than several hundred under him, and the isolated city fell only in the tenth month after a siege that had begun in the third, which shows how vast the gap between the two sides was. In the fighting at Heishi the Tongjian gives the number of heads taken as more than two thousand, while other accounts of the battle give three thousand and more; the Guardian of the Army, Chai Xiaohe, drowned. The camp at Heishi raised six beacon fires in succession to signal its distress. Li Mi's deployment at Shizihe ran for more than ten li from north to south, a depth of rather more than five kilometres. The battle of Shizihe in the eleventh month ended in a heavy defeat for the Sui with a flight to the west, and no tally of prisoners is recorded. In the action at the Luokou granary on the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth month, more than a thousand of the Sui were killed or drowned and their bravest general Fei Qingnu was killed; on the grain side, the price of rice in the eastern capital that year rose to three thousand cash a dou. As to the timetable, the business ran from the night crossing of the Luo on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month to the attempt on the storehouse on the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth, about two months in all, in which the Sui army first won, then lost, then lost again, and the balance of attack and defence was reversed entirely between Heishi and Shizihe.
cause: 大業年間，隋朝的統治已從根基處斷裂。連年征發高句麗，天下供輸與役使無已，江南轉輸之渠上船隻相接，倉儲與戶籍成為強徵的對象，山東河北一帶的丁口大批亡入山林與澤藪，起義因此接連不斷。瓦崗軍正是這股亂流中最大的一支：翟讓在滑州瓦崗寨聚眾起事，李密於大業十二年率眾來投，用計大破隋廷最能打的張須陀部，聲勢遂盛，轉而屯兵洛口、久圍洛口倉，把刀口直接抵在東都城下。隋廷的應手，是把河南僅存的野戰兵力集中起來反攻：虎賁郎將劉長恭率留守兵、寵玉率偃師兵，會同江都通守王世充等湊成十餘萬眾，隋煬帝自江都下詔令各軍皆受王世充節度，就是要把這個內部的口子一次堵死。對王世充而言，這一戰同時是立功的機會：他屢敗之後聲望受損，又被越王侗派使勞問，既羞且懼，急需一場勝利把東都的兵權與權位抓穩，因此主動請戰，士卒也得以盡數投入這一次冒險。
causeEn: Under the Daye era the Sui state had cracked at its foundations. The repeated levies for the campaigns against Goguryeo drew on the whole empire, the transport of goods along the waterways of the south took every available hand, the storehouses and the registers of households became instruments of forced extraction, and in the eastern provinces the population fled by tens of thousands into the forests and the marshes, so that risings followed one another without pause. The Wagang army was the largest of these torrents. Zhai Rang raised his band at Wanggang in the region of Hua, Li Mi brought his followers to join him in the twelfth year of Daye, and by a stratagem they destroyed the troops of Zhang Xuotuo, the best fighting man the Sui court still had; the movement grew in strength, moved to hold Luokou, and settled into a long siege of the Luokou granary, which put the point of the knife directly against the walls of the eastern capital. The court's answer was to concentrate in one stroke the last field army the empire had left in Henan: the Tiger Guard Colonel Liu Changgong led the garrison troops, Chongyu led those of Yanshi, and with the Jiangdu Circuit Commander Wang Shichong and the rest they assembled a host of more than a hundred thousand, while an edict from Emperor Yang at Jiangdu placed all of it under Wang Shichong's command, in order to close the hole in the empire's flank in a single move. For Wang Shichong the battle was also his opportunity to make a name: after a run of defeats his standing had suffered, the Prince of Yue had sent an envoy to console him, and he was both ashamed and afraid, so he needed a victory to secure the troops and the position at Luoyang. He therefore asked for the battle, and the soldiers were able to commit everything to this single gamble.
impact: 黑石與石子河兩戰之後，局勢急轉。瓦崗軍不但解除了洛口倉之圍，還取得河南大部的歸附，通鑑稱「河南諸郡盡附李密」，李密由此號令一方，兵鋒直指洛陽；隋廷在東都只剩城防與糧餉，再無野戰能力，而唐軍同年十一月攻克長安，代王侑即位，隋朝兩大樞紐在同月內相繼淪陷，東都的守臣第一次不得不正視改朝換代的可能。內部層面的代價同樣沉重：同年十二月瓦崗軍清洗首領，翟讓被殺，王儒信的挑動、房彥藻與鄭頲的進言、蔡建德的一刀，把最後一道平衡打破，徐世勣、單雄信、王伯當、裴仁基等舊將與李密之間的距離拉開；王世充聽到翟讓死訊反而嘆息，說「李密天資明決，為龍為蛇，固不可測也」。這場戰爭因此既是瓦崗由亂軍走向強勢的轉折點，也替一年後的分崩埋下種子：名將柴孝和死於黑石之水，攻城與襲營的銳氣折損一半。
impactEn: After the two battles of Heishi and Shizihe the situation turned over. The Wagang army not only raised the siege of the Luokou granary but drew the greater part of Henan to its side, the Tongjian saying that all the prefectures of Henan submitted to Li Mi; Li Mi could now give orders in his own right and his spearhead pointed at Luoyang, while the Sui at the eastern capital kept nothing but its walls and its rations and no longer had the power to fight in the open. In the same month Tang forces took Chang'an and Prince Yu took the throne, so that the two pivots of the Sui state fell within weeks of each other and the officials at Luoyang had to face for the first time the possibility of a change of dynasty. The cost inside the movement was heavy as well. In the twelfth month the Wagang purged its leading men and Zhai Rang was killed: the provocation of Wang Ruxin, the words of Fang Yanzhao and Zheng Ting, and the single stroke of Cai Jiande destroyed the last balance, and the distance opened between Li Mi and the old commanders Xu Shiji, Shan Xiongxin, Wang Bodang and Pei Renji. Wang Shichong, hearing of Zhai Rang's death, actually sighed and said that Li Mi was by nature clear-sighted and resolute, a dragon or a snake in the end, and beyond prediction. This war was therefore at once the turning point that carried the Wagang army from a band of rebels to a power in its own right, and the seed of the collapse that followed a year later: the fine general Chai Xiaohe drowned in the Luo at Heishi, and half the vigour of the assaulting and raiding arm was gone with him.
result: 就大業十三年這一段而言，結果是清楚的：十月黑石之戰，隋軍被李密以直搗大營再回身邀擊之法制服，斬首二千餘級，圍月城之役作廢，護軍柴孝和溺死；十一月石子河再會，翟讓先鋒失利而退，王伯當、裴仁基橫斷其後，李密勒中軍反擊，王世充大敗西走，兩軍自此攻守易位；十二月廿四夜襲洛口倉，瓦崗設伏，隋軍驍將費青奴被殺，戰死溺死千餘人，一度攻入倉城又被迫退出，王世充此後「堅壁不出」，不再主動求戰。瓦崗軍贏得了洛口倉與河南的實地，也贏得了人心，李密一時成為中原最強的武裝力量。但勝負並未因此終結：同年冬天瓦崗內部清洗，核心將領流失，名將折損，隋朝餘部仍在東都死守，唐朝則已入關中。一場在洛水北岸贏下來的戰役，決定了隋亡唐興的走向，也把李密推到了一個更高、也更危險的位置上。
resultEn: For the stretch of the Daye thirteenth year itself the outcome is plain. In October, at Heishi, the Sui army was beaten by Li Mi through a turning stroke that struck straight at the great camp and then turned to meet the enemy on the return, more than two thousand heads were taken, the siege of Yuecheng was abandoned, and the Guardian of the Army Chai Xiaohe drowned. In November they met again at Shizihe: Zhai Rang's vanguard gave ground, Wang Bodang and Pei Renji cut across the rear of the Sui, Li Mi held his centre and struck, and Wang Shichong was badly beaten and fled west, so that from that day the two armies stood in reversed positions. On the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth month the Wagang night-attacked the Luokou granary and lay in ambush; the Sui bravest, Fei Qingnu, was killed, more than a thousand were killed or drowned, the storehouse was entered and then abandoned, and after that Wang Shichong 'held his walls and did not come out', no longer offering to fight. The Wagang army had won the granary of Luokou, won the ground of Henan and won the people, and for a time Li Mi was the strongest armed force in the central plains. But the business was not settled by that victory: within the same winter the Wagang purged its own leaders, its core commanders drifted away, a famous general was lost, the surviving Sui held out at the eastern capital, and the Tang had already entered Guanzhong. A battle won on the north bank of the Luo decided the shape of the Sui collapse and the Tang rise, and it set Li Mi on a higher and far more dangerous pedestal.
